g.title: orbit_demo
g.text: orbit_demo (LANES=4, T_THROTTLE=80, T_STOP=95, T_RECOVER=70) clock domain: clk reset: rst_n (sync, active low) to all flip-flops power domain: single VDD/VSS

g.title: cluster_lane
g.text: g_lane[i].u_lane : orbit_mac_lane (x4, i = 0..3; lane i uses in_a/in_b[8*i +: 8], drives out_data[32*i +: 32])

g.title: faultq
g.text: set by mismatch, cleared by clear_fault/rst_n

g.title: ovq
g.text: set on in_fire & in_last, cleared on out_fire

g.title: nxt
g.text: nxt (next-state logic from voted, temp_valid, t = signed temp_c)
STOP if !temp_valid or t >= 95; NORMAL->THROTTLE at t >= 80; ->NORMAL at t <= 70
